comment: Structural registry of Underdog weekly NFL draft tournaments. Only formats with VERIFIED structure belong here - never guess rounds or roster bounds. roster_min/roster_max keys are QB/RB/WR/TE. payouts_file names a JSON in this directory with that contest's prize table; formats without one use the labeled placeholder curve. Structure sources: Underdog's official pick-by-pick archives (storage.googleapis.com/underdog-inc), help center, and corroborating media - see the format-catalog research (2026-09-12).

formats.name: Battle Royale
formats.notes: Flagship weekly, Sunday main slate, weeks 1-18. Archive-proven: 6x6, FLEX=RB/WR/TE, 30s clock. 2025 cap 55,992 at $7 (2023-24 fields 28-68k). OUT-before-kickoff players auto-swap to an undrafted player when legal.

formats.name: Battle Royale - Wild Card
formats.notes: All six Wild Card games. Archive-proven 6x6, two postseasons (Jan 2025: 32,088; Jan 2026: 30,468). ~$5 entry, ~$200k pool / $20k first (media-sourced) - no verified prize table yet, placeholder curve applies.

formats.name: Battle Royale - Divisional
formats.notes: All four Divisional games. Archive-proven 6x6, two postseasons. Fee/prizes unverified - placeholder curve applies.

formats.name: Battle Royale - Conf Championship
formats.notes: Two-game championship slate; rooms shrink to 4 drafters (archive-proven: picks 1-24, 4x6). Jan 2025: 40,148 entries; Jan 2026: 48,156. Fee/prizes unverified - placeholder curve applies. TE2 builds spike on this slate.

formats.name: The Turkey
formats.notes: Thanksgiving three-game slate. Archive-proven 4x6 in 2023 and 2024 (2024: 39,992 entries in 9,998 rooms); 2022 ran 6-seat and one 2025 article claims 6-seat again - CONFIRM the lobby seat count before drafting. Fee/prizes unverified - placeholder curve applies.

formats.name: Battle Royale - Single Game (TNF/SNF/MNF)
formats.notes: One primetime game; 3 drafters x 4 rounds, NO QBs (sourced verbatim from Underdog's content arm, c.2022-23). Per-position flex caps are UNVERIFIED (no-cap assumed) and 2025-26 existence unconfirmed - verify the lobby rules card before using this format. Field size is a guess; fee/prizes unverified.
